sources.note: Main homepage. Claims 180,000+ physicians, 850,000+ healthcare professionals, 110,000+ facilities. Highlights Sunoh.ai scribe, healow Genie AI contact center, and specialty solutions.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Describes FHIR API availability (patient-centric via healow, provider-centric via eCW), EHI export certification under (b)(10), predictive DSI functionality, and communication condition compliance.
Products and services overview. Describes four main areas: EHR for Practices, Patient Engagement, Value-Based Care, and Revenue Cycle Management. Lists key features for each area.

EHR product page. Details AI enhancements (Sunoh.ai, AI Assistant, healow Genie, Image AI, Automated Playlists), PRISMA health information search engine, cloud hosting on Microsoft Azure, and specialty support.
Pricing page. EHR only $449/mo/provider, EHR+PM $599/mo/provider, RCM as a service 2.9% of collections.
Press release announcing $900M projected 2023 revenue, up from $800M in 2022. Highlights AI investment strategy.
Company history blog post. Founded 1999 by Girish Kumar Navani, started with 5 employees, growth milestones.

G2 reviews. Average rating ~3.3-3.7/5. Users praise comprehensive feature set and customizability. Common complaints: click-heavy navigation, steep learning curve, mobile app issues, inconsistent support.
Capterra reviews. Similar themes: strong features but complex navigation, learning curve, and mixed support experience.
EMRSystems 2024 review. Highlights customizable templates, population health, telehealth integration, AI tools.
Market share data. eCW estimated at 13.24% EHR market share, ranked #2 in ambulatory EHR.
DOJ press release on 2017 $155M settlement. eCW falsely certified Meaningful Use compliance, hardcoded drug codes, failed audit logging and other requirements, paid kickbacks.
Interoperability page. PRISMA aggregates records from multiple EHRs, hospitals, payers, wearables via Carequality and TEFCA networks.
Medical Advantage consultant guide to eCW v12. Describes specialty modules, AI integration, clinical documentation workflows.
Product overview highlighting scheduling, patient registration, billing, patient portal, and telehealth features.
